Class Board

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.board.Board
public class Board extends Object
Acts as the central facade for the game board state.

This class aggregates and manages all the physical components shared among players, including the decks, the currently showed cards (tribe and buildings), the offer track for totem placement, and the progression of game eras.

    • Board

      public Board(OfferCardTrack track, OfferTurnCard turnOrder, Deck<Card> tribeDeck, Deck<BuildingCard> buildingDeck, List<Integer> buildingsPerEra, int numPlayers)
      Creates a new Board with the specified components and configuration.
      Parameters:
      track - the track managing offer cards and totem placements
      turnOrder - the turn order card tracking the turn progression
      tribeDeck - the deck containing Character and Event cards
      buildingDeck - the deck containing Building cards
      buildingsPerEra - a list defining how many building cards to display per era
      numPlayers - the number of players participating in the game

    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(Player player, char position)
      Places a player's totem on the specified position of the offer track. Ensures that players act in the correct sequential order.
      Parameters:
      player - the player attempting to place the totem
      position - the character identifier of the chosen offer track card
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if it is not the specified player's turn

    • returnTotem

      public void returnTotem(Player player)
      Returns the player's totem to the offer turn card after they complete their pick phase.
      Parameters:
      player - the player returning their totem

    • getPickOrder

      public List<Player> getPickOrder()
      Determines the sequential order of players for the offer phase, based on their totem placements.
      Returns:

    • takeCard

      public Card takeCard(PlayerContext playerContext, String cardId)
      Attempts to acquire a specific card from the currently displayed rows. The method searches through both the tribe cards and the building cards.
      Parameters:
      playerContext - the context of the players in game, with current player
      cardId - the unique identifier of the desired card
      Returns:
      the requested Card instance
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the card is not found on the board

    • setupBoard

      public void setupBoard(List<Player> players)
      Initializes the board for the very first turn of the game. Populates the initial rows of showed cards and randomizes the starting totem order.

    • endTurn

      public void endTurn(NotificatorCenter nc, PlayerContext playerContext)
      Concludes the current turn, triggers necessary card effects, and prepares the board for the next turn. This includes shifting card rows and potentially advancing to the next era.
      Parameters:
      nc - the NotificatorCenter to handle end-of-turn card effects
      playerContext - the context of the active player ending the turn

    • fromSnapshot

      public static Board fromSnapshot(BoardSnapshot snapshot, Map<String,Card> cardMap, List<Player> players)
      Restores a previously saved board state from a snapshot and pre-loaded card mappings.
      Parameters:
      snapshot - the serialized state of the board
      cardMap - a dictionary mapping unique card IDs to their instantiated Card objects
      players - the list of active players in the game
      Returns:
      a fully restored Board instance
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a card ID from the snapshot is missing in the provided dictionary
